verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a bulk-operations capability, such as selecting many alerts, dashboards or views and acting on them together. The closest items are adjacent rather than direct: cloning a dashboard section with its panels, editing dashboards as JSON or code, log-drop filters, and the Datadog migration tool. None of these is a general multi-item bulk action, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
